'''Nikos Chrysogelos'''  ({{Langx|el|Νίκος Χρυσόγελος}}; born 13 May 1959) is a [[Greece|Greek]] chemist and politician. In 2012, he replaced [[Michalis Tremopoulos]] as a [[member of the European Parliament]] (MEP) for the [[Ecologist Greens]]. In 2014 he however left his party to found the new [[Greens (Greece)|Greens]] party which in the [[January 2015 Greek legislative election|January 2015 legislative election]] formed a common electoral list with [[Democratic Left (Greece)|Democratic Left]],<ref>{{cite web|title=Green change in Greece|publisher=[[European Green Party]]|url=http://europeangreens.eu/news/greekelections|date=9 January 2015|accessdate=26 January 2015|archive-date=24 October 2015|archive-url=https://archive.today/20151024114855/http://europeangreens.eu/news/greekelections|url-status=dead}}</ref> but missed the 3% [[electoral threshold]].
